name: Intercom
description: Let agents read client conversations in Intercom, look up the person and company behind them, leave internal notes for your team and assign conversations. If you allow it, they can also reply to clients.
identity: The access token of an app in your Intercom workspace. It acts as the workspace, with the permissions you tick on the app, so keep them to the ones below.

setup.title: Create an app for agents
setup.body: You need an Intercom admin for this. An app made in your own workspace gets an access token for that workspace straight away.
click: Open the Intercom Developer Hub (app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/developer-hub) and select New app.
Name it Agents, pick your workspace, then Create app.

setup.title: Set its permissions and copy the token
setup.body: Tick only the permissions below, then copy the access token for the form below.
click: In the app, go to Configure, then Authentication, and select Edit.
Tick only the permissions below, then Save.
Copy the Access token shown on the same page.

fields.label: API address
fields.help: api.intercom.io, or api.eu.intercom.io or api.au.intercom.io if your workspace is hosted in Europe or Australia.

capabilities.label: Read conversations
capabilities.description: List and read conversations, read a person's contact record, look up a company (its plan and custom attributes, such as what it is entitled to) and its people, and list your teammates.
capabilities.note: Reaches every conversation, person and company in the workspace. Read-only.
scopes: Read and list users and companies

capabilities.label: Add notes and assign
capabilities.description: Leave an internal note on a conversation, which clients never see, and assign a conversation to a teammate or team.

capabilities.label: Reply to clients
capabilities.description: Reply to a conversation as a teammate. The client sees the reply.

revoke: In the Intercom Developer Hub, open the app, go to Configure, then Authentication, and regenerate the access token, or delete the app. Agents lose access to Intercom at once.

tools.name: intercom_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations, most recently updated first.

starting_after.description: The next page's cursor, from the previous answer

tools.name: intercom_get_conversation
tools.description: Read one conversation with its messages, as plain text.

tools.name: intercom_get_contact
tools.description: Read one person's contact record: name, email, companies and custom attributes.

contact_id.description: The contact id (from a conversation's contacts)

tools.name: intercom_find_company
tools.description: Find a company by your own company id or by name: its plan, size and custom attributes, such as what it is entitled to.

company_id.description: Your own id for the company

tools.name: intercom_list_company_contacts
tools.description: List the people at a company.

id.description: Intercom's id for the company (its id field, not company_id)

tools.name: intercom_list_admins
tools.description: List your teammates (admins), with their ids, emails and whether they are away. Use an id to assign a conversation or to write as that teammate.

tools.name: intercom_add_note
tools.description: Leave an internal note on a conversation. Clients never see notes.

admin_id.description: The teammate the note is from

body.description: The note, as text or simple HTML

tools.name: intercom_assign_conversation
tools.description: Assign a conversation to a teammate or a team, with an optional note.

assignee_id.description: The teammate or team to assign it to

type.description: Whether assignee_id is a teammate or a team

body.description: An optional note with the assignment

tools.name: intercom_reply
tools.description: Reply to a conversation as a teammate. The client sees the reply.

admin_id.description: The teammate the reply is from

body.description: The reply, as text or simple HTML
